name: mammoth-parked-empty-engine-off
note: Mammoth (CAT 793D) series-spring bench, 2026-10-14: parked, empty, handbrake on, ENGINE OFF (no engine statement is sent: the Mammoth class plays shakers EngineStart/EngineShutdown its prop_truck_shaker_native_controller does not define, which crashed launch 1 at engine start), no pedal or steer, 40 s of 10 Hz probes after the scene is ready. roamer105_acceptance pad (flat_pad top y 60.0, x -30..30, z -50..50; terrain 42.5 below it), truck at the scene's own approved_roamer place (0, 61.2, -18), clear of the wheel steps (z 0..8), the water (x -12) and the ramps (x 12). Wheel depth is measured against the pad (analysis.groundHeight) and the terrain probe. Sprung-body modelled offsets assume the chassis body origin is the tpl origin (series_spring_rc61.py bone heads: front wheel centres +-2.504/1.682/3.387, rear heave and roll bodies 0/1.682/-2.33); constraint names are <child body>|<parent body> (Game, readback 2026-10-14). The chassis body GetForward is world-down, so hull pitch reads -90 at rest.
